fields.name: Tidewater Review
fields.tagline: A second tenant on the same substrate, with its own data, members and theme.
fields.about: Tidewater Review exists to show that two publications can share one substrate and nothing else. Its schema is the same template as Fieldnotes; its records, members, sessions and events are entirely its own.

fields.title: High Water at Six
fields.excerpt: The only published article of the second tenant.
fields.body: The tide comes in whether or not anyone is watching. This article belongs to Tidewater Review and to nobody else.
